issue.title: bench_tui_jk Archive warm-open-to-first-rows exceeds its budget on athena with no owning bead

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Not intermittent on athena: phase sase-1q5.5 (epic sase-1q5) ran `pytest -s -m slow tests/ace/tui/bench_tui_jk.py` on 2026-10-30, once on the clean-tree baseline (8 failed, 11 passed, 592.78 s) and once after its change (8 failed, 11 passed, 614.51 s). The archive warm-open budget node failed both times. The phase's change (Agents capacity/title patches and runtime aggregation) does not touch the Archive view. The other seven failing nodes already have owners (sase-1ge, sase-1gf, sase-lx, sase-199), each corroborated with the same evidence on 2026-10-31. This node had none. Next step: rerun on a quiet host to separate a host-load budget miss from a real Archive warm-open regression. Then either fix the warm-open path or recalibrate the budget with evidence. Reported in sase-1q5.5 note #1.

issue.creation_reason: The Archive warm-open bench failed on both the clean baseline and the post-change run of phase sase-1q5.5's j/k benchmark. The seven sibling failing nodes already have owners, but this one had none.

payload.description: Sibling bench_tui_jk failures from the same sase-1q5.5 runs
